transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. I'd like to get our preflight meeting underway so we can move toward final sign-off on the showcase package. As a reminder, the showcase is set for one evening at the Harborlight Theater, immediately after the feature-film premiere. Before I approve anything, I need the technical director and the music rights coordinator to report their final checks. Could we start with those updates?

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue. I received the completed power survey from the Harborlight electrician this morning.
